task: Harden the Octopus Qdrant healthcheck repair implementation produced by Codex Worker run 33453111408 on branch codex/run-33453111408-1, commit 3fe79a50f0ef9c0d6129a7b8c25f07d388729358. Preserve the existing narrowly scoped ChatGPT Ops control-plane design and do not deploy, access production, or use production credentials. Fix these review blockers: (1) Starting the Octopus web service must not manage or recreate its dependencies. Verify the Octopus postgres service/container is already healthy using read-only checks, then start web with docker compose up -d --no-deps web. Maintain the guarantee that this action does not modify PostgreSQL data, volumes, schema, migrations, model rows, or unrelated containers. (2) /api/version must verify the actual returned Octopus version is 1.0.122, not merely an HTTP-success status. Inspect the endpoint/source contract and parse the real response format rather than guessing; a mismatch must fail closed. (3) Make the repair resumable/idempotent for exactly the two known healthcheck states: the exact old broken wget healthcheck should be patched; the exact expected new dependency-free healthcheck should be accepted as already patched and the action should continue. Any other healthcheck state must fail closed. (4) Add focused tests proving --no-deps is used for web, no postgres compose-up/recreate/database mutation is performed, version mismatch fails, exact fixed-state reruns are accepted, and unexpected healthcheck variants fail closed. Reuse the prior implementation patterns where sound. Keep the change narrowly scoped to the Octopus repair action, its allowlist/dispatcher wiring if needed, and focused tests. Read CLAUDE.md and the existing operator/control-plane patterns before editing. Do not weaken existing production safety guards or print secrets/admin credentials.
